title: Who will be the next James Bond? – level 2
paragraphs: Actors Jack Lowden, Josh O’Connor, and Callum Turner are reportedly in the final auditions to play the next James Bond. Testing involves three main parts: performing stunts, delivering dialogue, and showing strong screen presence.

Jack Lowden is currently the favorite among betting groups, though all three actors bring special styles to the famous role. Experts say that producers want a British or Commonwealth actor, though a surprise candidate could still be selected.
Studio executives hope to make a press announcement around Christmas to reveal the new 007 actor to fans worldwide.
